design.unit: same deck pair, same seed, same family; two first-player values crossed with two candidate-seat values
design.primaryExclusion: Exclude the entire four-game unit if any result is missing, non-victory, or anomalous; retain all raw natural counts and exclusion details.

bootstrap.resampling: Within each family, resample complete clean four-game unitIds with replacement; sample the same count of units per replicate. Sort units by unitId before sampling.
bootstrap.aggregate: Only pooled descriptive point estimates; no aggregate interval and never treat all 384 games as independent.
bootstrap.smallN: Single-unit percentile intervals are explicitly marked degenerate; zero clean units return no interval.
